description: Pin a finding (a saved, titled view) to a dataset you own. Finding views use the rows.page query language in q: `word` or `"two words"` searches text columns; `field:value`, `field:"a b"`, `-field:value`, `field:*` (not null), `-field:*` (null), `field:foo*` (prefix); `field:>20`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `field:10..20`, ISO dates (`at:>2026-09-01`); dot paths for nested JSON (`payload.customer.country:NL`); `tags:urgent` means the list contains it; combine with `OR` and parentheses. A q starting with SELECT, WITH or FROM runs as SQL against the table `data`. sort is comma-separated columns, `-` for descending (`-price,name`); cols picks and orders visible columns (`a,b,c`).
